moments.title: Summer Bank Holiday Weekend
moments.blurb: The UK (excluding Scotland) looks forward to the last long weekend of summer, with the Summer Bank Holiday falling on Monday, August 31st.

angles.name: Relaxed Vibe
angles.copy: That long weekend feeling is almost here! Who's ready for an extra day off to soak up the last of the summer vibes? What are your plans for the Bank Holiday? #BankHoliday

angles.name: Travel & Fun
angles.copy: Don't forget, the Summer Bank Holiday is this Monday! Perfect for a last-minute getaway or a local adventure. Where are you heading this weekend?

moments.title: Champions League Group Stage Draw
moments.blurb: The draw for the 2026/27 UEFA Champions League 'League Phase' takes place tomorrow, Thursday August 27th, at 5pm BST in Monaco, as Europe's elite discover their fate.

angles.name: Anticipation
angles.copy: The biggest club competition in Europe is back! Who do you want your team to draw in tomorrow's Champions League group stage? Drop your predictions!

angles.name: Team Focus
angles.copy: Tomorrow, the road to the Champions League final in Madrid begins. Which English team do you think has the best chance in the draw? #UCL

moments.title: All Points East Festival Continues
moments.blurb: London's All Points East festival continues at Victoria Park through Sunday, August 30th, featuring headline sets from Tyler, The Creator, Lorde, Twenty One Pilots, and Deftones.

angles.name: Current Buzz
angles.copy: All Points East is still rocking Victoria Park! Who are you most excited to see before the festival wraps up this weekend? #APE2026

angles.name: London Vibe
angles.copy: Victoria Park is buzzing! All Points East continues to bring the biggest names to East London. What's been your highlight so far?

moments.title: Happy 60th Birthday, Shirley Manson!
moments.blurb: Garbage frontwoman Shirley Manson, known for her distinctive voice and rebellious style, celebrates her 60th birthday today.

angles.name: Iconic Frontwoman
angles.copy: Happy 60th Birthday to the incredible Shirley Manson! The iconic voice of Garbage, still as fierce and relevant as ever. What's your favourite Garbage track?

angles.name: Garbage Hits
angles.copy: Celebrating Shirley Manson's 60th today! From 'Stupid Girl' to 'Only Happy When It Rains', Garbage's sound defined an era. What's on your playlist?

moments.title: Happy 69th Birthday, Gloria Estefan!
moments.blurb: Cuban-American superstar Gloria Estefan, the 'Queen of Latin Pop' and Miami Sound Machine lead singer, turns 69 on September 1st.

angles.name: Latin Pop Legend
angles.copy: Get on your feet and celebrate! Gloria Estefan turns 69 on Sunday. What's your favourite hit from the Queen of Latin Pop?

angles.name: Miami Sound
angles.copy: Conga! On September 1st, we're wishing a very happy 69th birthday to Gloria Estefan. Her music with Miami Sound Machine still brings the sunshine!

moments.title: Premier League Weekend Action
moments.blurb: The Premier League serves up another weekend of action, with fixtures including Liverpool vs Nottingham Forest, Spurs vs Newcastle on Saturday, and Chelsea vs Brighton, Man Utd vs Ipswich on Sunday.

angles.name: Weekend Kick-off
angles.copy: Premier League is back this weekend! Which fixture are you most looking forward to? Can Liverpool continue their strong start or will Spurs stun Newcastle?

angles.name: London Derby Focus
angles.copy: Big weekend for London clubs! Chelsea host Brighton on Sunday. Who's taking the points in this clash?

moments.title: Official Singles Chart Update
moments.blurb: The new Official UK Singles Chart Top 40 will be announced this Friday, with 'Rein Me In' by Sam Fender and Olivia Dean currently holding the Number 1 spot for the week ending August 27th.

angles.name: Chart Battle
angles.copy: Who will be crowned the UK's Official Number 1 this Friday? Sam Fender & Olivia Dean are currently holding strong with 'Rein Me In'! Can anyone knock them off?

angles.name: New Music Friday Prep
angles.copy: New music is coming, but who's taking the top spot this week? The Official Singles Chart is updated Friday! What track do you want to see hit Number 1?

moments.title: Happy 45th Birthday, Beyoncé!
moments.blurb: Global icon Beyoncé, the multi-Grammy-winning singer, songwriter, and performer, celebrates her 45th birthday on September 4th.

angles.name: Queen Bey
angles.copy: Bow down! Queen Bey turns 45 this Friday. Get ready to celebrate Beyoncé's birthday with us! What's your ultimate Beyoncé power anthem?

angles.name: Era Spanning Hits
angles.copy: From Destiny's Child to Renaissance, Beyoncé has dominated for decades. Wishing her a very happy 45th birthday on September 4th! Which era of Bey is your favourite?

moments.title: Happy 83rd Birthday, Roger Waters!
moments.blurb: Pink Floyd co-founder, bassist, and principal songwriter Roger Waters celebrates his 83rd birthday on September 6th.

angles.name: Rock Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Roger Waters on September 6th! A true visionary behind some of Pink Floyd's greatest works. What's your favourite Waters-era track?

angles.name: Pink Floyd Genius
angles.copy: The creative force behind 'The Wall' and 'Dark Side of the Moon' turns 83 this Sunday! Happy Birthday, Roger Waters. Tune in for some Pink Floyd classics!

moments.blurb: The Premier League action rolls into next weekend with big matches including Manchester City vs Coventry, Everton vs Manchester United, and Arsenal vs Chelsea.
